limitations: Series cluster metadata derives from the final parsed match; for uncertainty grouping only, not a model input
Results are post-hoc descriptive sensitivity on an already opened TEST set
Future source reparses may change metadata
method: Paired series-cluster bootstrap; resample 54 series IDs (with replacement), aggregate all per-minute M1-M0 losses within each sampled series; divide summed differences by total sampled minute observations; percentile 2.5/97.5, 10,000 draws. No refit or model selection.
scope: POST-HOC descriptive series-cluster sensitivity on pinned heldout predictions; no fitting, model selection or recalibration
